column3: Idempotency keys are ingle-browser:<pi.provider sessionId>:<generation>:<create|delete>, committed in xin.browser before the call
column4: Conversation ids are per Home and restart at 1, while one Instabox key serves every Home; the provider UUIDv7 is per conversation and fresh on fork. Every machine is created once and deleted once, and a reopen after any close is generation+1, so an old create (Instabox keeps keys 7 days) is never replayed
column5: probe: a replayed delete with its key returned the same operation; browser.test.ts lifecycle lists create 1, delete 1, create 2
